seen: Satellite z19: a small block (~40 x 55 m) south of the road in front of the 15-storey tower. North entrance: light tan paving with a yellow flower bed by the road, a grey path south between two dense tree groups to a light grey paved plaza in the middle. On the plaza two dark brown rectangles: a wooden deck (west) and a raised shade pergola (east, it casts a shadow north). SW: a fan-shaped red-brown rubber play surface with a yellow play structure. South: a narrow paved alley along the west side of 원미별마루 to the south road. Web (gonggam design blog, Bucheon city blog): grey granite-like block paving with dark accent tiles, a dark brown brick wall with a long brick bench and the 'Starlight Park' sign over the rubber surface, star projections on the alley floor at night.
